The '''Corfai system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Corellian sector/Legends|Corellian sector]] within the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corfai]].
